scripts.release-checks: vp run template:check && vp run ui:verify
scripts.ui:components: shadcn add button card input label badge alert field separator direction skeleton empty sidebar breadcrumb collapsible dropdown-menu avatar sheet tooltip navigation-menu use-mobile table spinner tabs --overwrite --yes
scripts.ui:blocks: shadcn add @shadcn/sidebar-16 -c packages/ui --diff src/blocks/sidebar-16/components/app-sidebar.tsx && shadcn add @shadcn/sidebar-16 -c packages/ui --diff src/blocks/sidebar-16/components/nav-main.tsx && shadcn add @shadcn/sidebar-16 -c packages/ui --diff src/blocks/sidebar-16/components/site-header.tsx
scripts.ui:verify: vp run ui:theme && vp run ui:components && git diff --exit-code -- packages/ui/src/components packages/ui/src/styles src/lib
